S Key modifications: selected complete English senses, preserved case and punctuation, split semicolons only outside parentheses, resolved Chinese cross-references with cycle limits, and indexed simplified and traditional forms. Ordinary pinyin readings precede capitalized proper-name readings; source sense order is otherwise retained. Single characters and metadata are excluded. No contextual disambiguation is claimed.
